critique: The global minimax expansion is supported by a separate schedule-uniform estimator and all-design Bayes-prior sandwich, so the open uniform-singular-bridge question does not leave the stated sharp constant or allocation frontier unproved. What remains unproved is the stronger claim that the stratified face/corner experiment itself arises through a uniform liminf-and-recovery comparison across transverse eta strata; the note delivers only the tangent program, spectral calculation, and global value bounds. The contribution is confined to one fixed three-arm contrast with a common bounded outcome interval, and the nominally computable finite-orbit certificates are not accompanied by actual calculations, code, or finite-sample evidence showing the practical size of the second-order gain. The related-work prose also repeatedly calls recent arXiv preprints “published” and relies rhetorically on a non-archival repository parent, although the essential orbit reduction is reproved in the note. These scope, evidence, and positioning limitations keep the projected paper below the strongest leading-journal contributions despite clearing the field-tier floor.
